screen.webgui.title: Web
message.webgui.mcef_not_ready: WebGUI is not ready yet. Wait for Chromium to finish loading or check the log.
message.webgui.hud_interactive_on: Web HUD: interactive mode (pseudo-GUI). Press the key again to exit.
message.webgui.hud_interactive_off: Web HUD: view only. Press the interactive mode key to enable input.
screen.webgui.settings.title: WebGUI Settings
screen.webgui.settings.inspector.on: Chrome DevTools: open %s in a browser
screen.webgui.settings.inspector.off: The inspector opens after a restart.
screen.webgui.settings.scroll.tip: How far one notch of the wheel carries a page. The game counts one notch where a browser counts several lines, so at low values a page moves less than the hand expects.
screen.webgui.settings.framerate.tip: How often a page may repaint. Higher is smoother and costs more CPU and GPU; a page that only shows text gains nothing from it. Unlimited leaves the choice to the browser.
screen.webgui.settings.downloads.tip: Off: a file a page offers is saved into webgui-downloads/ beside the game and you are told the name. On: the system save dialog opens for each one. Takes effect after a restart.
screen.webgui.settings.autoplay: Let pages play sound on their own
screen.webgui.settings.autoplay.tip: Off: video and audio on a page wait until you click it, the way a browser treats a tab you did not open. On: a page may start playing by itself. Takes effect after a restart.
screen.webgui.settings.devtools.tip: Writes browser errors, failed requests and console output to the game log, and opens the inspector on F12. Off by default: it makes the log noisy. Takes effect after a restart.
